Name: Grainfruit Wrap
Desc: A staple food wrapped in big leaves. There's a simple saying in Natlan that goes like this: "A leaf to wrap your Grainfruit with will always fall." It's used to express the idea of things being fated to happen.
Effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 107 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
